claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a NEXUS branded washing machine.
The physical location of the item cannot be confirmed through photos.

risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and completing a spin cycle.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker (usually on the back).
A photo of the inside of the machine with the lid open.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged or fouled interior

risks.risk: Missing or damaged drainage and power components
risks.proof: Photos of the rear of the machine showing the power cable and drain hose.
risks.if_unproven: as missing essential cables and hoses

proof_requests: Photo of the specification sticker showing the model number and KG capacity.
Photo of the interior tub with the lid open.
Video of the machine plugged in and running a cycle.
Photo of the back of the machine showing the hoses and power cord.
response.reason: The model and capacity, which are the primary drivers of value for NEXUS machines, are not visible. Furthermore, the interior condition and operational status must be verified before a baseline value can be established.
